title: the impact of logistics performance on agricultural exports in asean
core_idea: Examines the influence of logistics performance on agricultural trade flows from ASEAN countries by estimating an augmented gravity model using Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) on detailed product-level bilateral trade data for ten ASEAN economies and 196 trading partners from 2007 to 2022, incorporating multiple fixed effects and multilateral resistance terms.
tldr: Study investigates how logistics performance affects ASEAN agricultural exports using an augmented gravity model (PPML) on product-level bilateral data (2007–2022) with multiple fixed effects and multilateral resistance terms.
